question.problem:
Written in **ascending order**, the solutions to $|1-y|=8$ are $y=${{field-1}} and $y=$
{{field-2}}.
question.worked_solution:
Either the positive or negative of the expression inside the absolute value must be equal to the right-hand side of the equation.

So, we set up the two corresponding equations and solve them independently:

- If $|1-y|=1-y,$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|1-y| & =8 \\ 1-y & =8 \\ -y & =7 \\ y & =-7\end{aligned}
$$

- If $|1-y|=-(1-y),$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|1-y| & =8 \\ -(1-y) & =8 \\ -1+y & =8 \\ y & =9\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, in ascending order, the solutions are $y=-7$ and $y=9.$
